description.en: Share the cup style, artwork, dimensions and intended use.
description.zh: 提供杯型、设计稿、尺寸和使用场景。

description.en: We prepare a digital mockup of your design for review.
description.zh: 我们制作电子设计稿供您查看。

description.en: We prepare a sample so you can review the design and specifications.
description.zh: 我们安排打样，供您查看设计效果和规格。

description.en: Confirm the sample, final artwork and packing requirements.
description.zh: 确认样品、最终设计稿和包装要求。

description.en: We produce the order to the approved specifications.
description.zh: 我们按确认的规格安排批量生产。

description.en: We pack the order and coordinate the agreed shipping arrangements.
description.zh: 我们打包订单，按双方确认的运输方式安排发货。
